avb is a fast\-growing, stable company that has a firm mission to do whatever it takes to keep our members profitably in business. our vision is to deliver best\-in\-class growth solutions and service fueled by a passionate mission belief, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to doing what is right for our members, organization, and team members. avb has an experienced development team, smart strategy team, bright and creative designers, along with the rest of our dream team of enthusiastic, entrepreneurial\-minded individuals who want to help drive the success of our members!



we are always looking for smart, resourceful, and dynamic people to join the team, so if you are looking for a company that will welcome you, collaborate with you, challenge you, and help develop your skills to the next level, then we are looking for you! we are geared up for growth, are you ready to grow with us?



home \- avb marketing

  

**position type:**  

this is a **contract**position managed through deel and **open to candidates outside the us only** (philippines preferred).

  


**position summary/objective:**



the software engineer will collaborate with product, design, and the devops/it team to design, build, and support avb marketing’s e\-commerce, product information, and marketing technology platforms (linq and related systems) on aws. this is an ai\-assisted development role: the engineer is expected to use github copilot and development ide's daily to accelerate delivery in a codebase that may span .net, node.js, react, and python.

  


**essential functions and responsibilities:**


* end\-to\-end development: design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain web applications, apis, and background services.
* use ai coding assistants (github copilot or claude code, in vs code or as a standalone agent) daily for design, implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation; review and test all ai\-generated code and remain accountable for everything committed.
* build and maintain integrations with third\-party systems, including rest apis, pos and manufacturer data feeds, and e\-commerce platforms such as magento.
* work closely with the devops/it team on deployment procedures and support rollouts of your work.
* troubleshoot production issues using logs and monitoring tools (splunk, cloudwatch) and implement fixes.
* write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code and participate in code reviews through github pull requests.
* work independently on features of moderate scope and escalate blockers early.
* communicate status clearly and participate actively in agile ceremonies and project discussions.

  




**required skills and abilities:**


* proficiency in .net core / c\# development on aws, with working proficiency in at least one of node.js, react, or python.
* demonstrated proficiency in ai code\-assisted development using github copilot (vs code integration or standalone/agentic application), including prompt\-driven code generation, agent\-driven multi\-file changes, and ai\-assisted debugging and test generation.
* hands\-on experience with core aws services (lambda, s3, rds, cloudwatch).
* working knowledge of microsoft sql server and t\-sql.
* proficiency with git and github, including pull requests and code review.
* clear written and verbal communication in english and the ability to collaborate effectively with a u.s.\-based team.
* strong troubleshooting and critical thinking skills.

  




**education and experience:**


* bachelor’s degree (preferably in computer science or a related field) or equivalent experience.
* 1 to 2 years or more of hands\-on experience developing .net applications on aws, plus hands\-on experience with at least one of node.js, react, or python.
* experience working in an agile/scrum environment using jira and confluence.
* experience with api gateway, sqs/sns, and serverless or microservices architectures is a plus.
* experience with ci/cd pipelines (github actions) and applying aws security best practices (iam, secrets management) is a plus.
* advanced t\-sql experience (stored procedures, query performance tuning) is a plus.
* experience with web scraping frameworks or services (puppeteer, playwright, selenium, bright data) is a plus.
* experience integrating with point\-of\-sale (pos), erp, and/or e\-commerce platforms is a plus.
* relevant aws certifications are a plus.

  




**physical requirements:**


* prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  


**remote work/travel:**

* this position works remotely and is subject to avb’s remote work policies and procedures in effect at the time. **working hours are during u.s. time zone business hours (non\-negotiable)**, with the specific schedule set at the supervisor’s discretion, regardless of the engineer’s physical location.

title: PROJECT - Data Engineer II
description:
our deloitte ai \& engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. you'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

  

**work you'll do**  

  

as a project \- data engineer ii on the ai \& data team, you will be responsible for...  

* designing, developing, and maintaining batch and streaming data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and artificial intelligence use cases
* building and optimizing extract, transform, and load processes using sql, python, and data engineering frameworks
* integrating data from structured and unstructured sources across cloud and on\-premises environments
* supporting data quality, validation, monitoring, and issue resolution activities for production data assets
* collaborating with cross\-functional teams to implement data models, improve platform performance, and support client delivery objectives

  

a successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* effective written and verbal communication skills
* meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* ability to lead projects or workstreams
* ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* ability to meet deadlines
* ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**the team**  

  

deloitte's government \& public services (gps) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  

  

our ai \& data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge data and ai platforms, products, insights, and services. our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, ai, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.  

  

the project delivery talent model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery\-focused professionals.  

  

**qualifications**  

  

required:  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a similar quantitative field
* 0\-2 years of experience working in agile delivery environments
* 1\+ years of experience in extract, transform, and load architecture and development
* 1\+ years of experience using python and structured query language to build or support data pipelines
* 1\+ years of experience working with relational database management systems
* ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

preferred:  

* experience supporting federal, state, or local government clients
* experience with apache spark, databricks, snowflake, or apache airflow
* experience with application programming interfaces and request handling
* experience with docker
* experience supporting machine learning workflows
* experience with microsoft azure sql server or power platform

  

the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $140,600\.  

  

you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

title: Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE)-Innovation_Delivery_Transformation
description:
**the team**  

  

convergesports is a product\-driven business combining deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, ai\-native decision intelligence, and reusable converge capabilities. we help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics. cross\-functional product teams turn market needs into scalable products and repeatable decision workflows rather than one\-off solutions.  

  

**position summary**  

  

are you energized by both winning the work and delivering it? as a product forward deployed engineer on convergesports, you will sit between the market and the product, helping shape data strategy for sports organizations while feeding what you learn in the field straight back into what we build. if you want to be close to clients and close to the product at the same time, we would like to talk with you.  

  

recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\.  

  

**work you'll do**  

  

as a product forward deployed engineer, you will split your time between supporting go\-to\-market for the convergesports portfolio and delivering the work once it is sold, with an emphasis on data strategy and data\-product delivery. your work will include:  

* support product demonstrations and client conversations, translating convergesports data and digital products into a clear business case.
* contribute to go\-to\-market materials such as demo scripts, one\-pagers, and case studies that sales and product teams reuse across engagements.
* partner with product managers and market makers to qualify product fit and help scope delivery engagements.
* deliver client\-facing data work, including data discovery, segmentation, audience definition, and activation support.
* support customer data platform, identity, and audience workstreams alongside data engineering and data science partners.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**position summary**


flightwave aerospace is seeking a senior software engineer to develop embedded software for autonomous aircraft and uncrewed aerial systems. this engineer will own production c and c\+\+ software across microcontrollers and linux\-based application processors, integrate sensors and perception capabilities, and support systems from architecture and hardware bring\-up through ground and flight test.




the ideal candidate brings recent vtol, uas, or other vehicle embedded\-software experience; deep expertise in real\-time and embedded linux systems; and the judgment to diagnose issues spanning software, electronics, sensors, networks, and vehicle behavior. the role partners with electrical, systems, controls, autonomy, test, manufacturing, and flight\-operations teams.

  




**essential duties and responsibilities**


essential functions of a job that are crucial to its purpose and must be performed regularly. they are the fundamental tasks that an employee must be able to carry out, with or without reasonable accommodation, and are central to defining the role’s purpose.


* design, implement, review, and maintain embedded c and c\+\+ software for microcontrollers, application processors, and heterogeneous aircraft edge\-compute platforms.
* own features from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, release, and ground or flight\-test support.
* develop board\-support, device\-interface, middleware, and application\-layer software for real\-time operating systems and embedded linux.
* integrate cameras, eo/ir payloads, imus, gnss, radar, lidar, and other sensors with reliable data paths, time synchronization, health monitoring, and fault handling.
* develop or integrate perception capabilities including detection, tracking, localization, visual odometry, mapping, calibration, and multi\-sensor fusion as programs require.
* optimize cpu, gpu, memory, i/o, startup, latency, throughput, and power while preserving deterministic behavior on critical paths.
* define secure, stable interfaces among perception, autonomy, flight controls, vehicle management, communications, payloads, and operator applications.
* diagnose cross\-domain problems with target debuggers, traces, logic analyzers, telemetry, recorded sensor data, core dumps, and system logs.
* build and maintain unit, integration, software\-in\-the\-loop, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, regression, and performance tests.
* analyze ground and flight data, drive defects to root cause, and establish measurable timing, memory, reliability, and functional acceptance criteria.
* contribute to requirements traceability, design reviews, coding standards, configuration management, risk analysis, and program assurance evidence.
* provide technical leadership through architecture decisions, code reviews, mentorship, planning, and multidisciplinary coordination.
* deliver maintainable production software on target hardware with actionable logs, testable interfaces, and automated regression coverage.
* support prototype and production integration, scheduled test events, and other duties aligned with the role as assigned.
  




**required qualifications** – the following qualifications are required for any position:

* bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* seven or more years of professional software development, including recent hands\-on embedded development of aircraft, vtol/uas, autonomous vehicles, embedded systems, robotics, or comparable vehicle platforms.
* advanced embedded c and modern c\+\+ proficiency, including object lifetime, ownership, concurrency, integer behavior, memory layout, performance, and undefined\-behavior avoidance.
* production experience developing for both microcontrollers and application processors, such as arm cortex\-m and cortex\-a class devices or comparable architectures.
* experience with an rtos and embedded linux, including scheduling, multithreading, ipc, boot flow, device interfaces, and system\-level debugging.
* experience with vehicle and board interfaces such as dronecan/can/can fd, ethernet, spi, i2c, uart, mavlink, bdshot, and gpio, plus related transport or messaging protocols.




* experience integrating sensors or perception data on resource\-constrained platforms, accounting for calibration, timing, dropped data, vibration, lighting, latency, and environmental failure modes.
* experience taking software from design and hardware bring\-up through bench testing, vehicle integration, and field or flight testing.
* ability to create testable interfaces, automated tests, actionable logs, and measurable performance and reliability criteria.
* ability to explain technical decisions, lead reviews, mentor engineers, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  




**additional desired qualifications** – the requirements below are desired knowledge, skills and/or abilities we desire but not required.




* direct vtol, uas, autopilot, flight\-computer, or flight\-control ecosystem experience, including px4 or an equivalent platform.
* aerial\-vehicle perception experience in sensor fusion, visual\-inertial odometry, slam, gnss\-denied navigation, object detection, tracking, or terrain\-relative localization.
* embedded computer\-vision or machine\-learning optimization using opencv, eigen, cuda, tensorrt, onnx runtime, or comparable technologies.
* hands\-on nxp, qualcomm, or nvidia processor development, including board\-support packages, acceleration frameworks, profiling tools, and development kits.
* yocto project, openembedded, buildroot, custom linux distributions, bootloaders, kernel configuration, or device\-driver experience.
* qt and qml development for operator\-facing or engineering applications.
* docker\-based development or deployment workflows and cross\-compilation for target hardware.
* conan for c/c\+\+ dependency management and jfrog artifactory for binary artifacts.
* python and gitlab ci/cd or comparable automated tooling for test, data analysis, builds, packaging, static analysis, and release.
* familiarity with do\-178c, arp4754a, do\-254 interfaces, misra c/c\+\+, requirements\-based testing, structural coverage, or similar safety\-related methods.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**overview**
------------


at ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. make your move.


* job type: full time
* work type: hybrid

  
creating the future of smart mobility requires the highly intelligent use of data, metrics, and analytics. that’s where you can make an impact as part of our global data insight \& analytics (gdia) team. we are the trusted advisers that enable ford to clearly see business conditions, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. with our support, key decision\-makers can act in meaningful, positive ways. join us and use your data expertise and analytical skills to drive evidence\-based, timely decision\-making.


the marketing and enterprise analytics team within global data insights and analytics (gdi\&a) supports analytical solutions and insights across the enterprise in areas like corporate finance, office of general counsel, general auditors office, human resources, and others. the data scientist discovers and curates new and existing data sources to create insight for the business. this is an exciting opportunity to utilize the latest tools and methods in statistics, big data, data science, and applied generative ai to solve a variety of business problems and help build the next generation of intelligent, autonomous systems.


the role spans the full project lifecycle from analytic problem definition, through data gathering, analysis, model development, agentic workflow design, reporting/visualization development, testing, and operational deployment.


as a data scientist, you will join the product team, collaborating closely with product managers, product designers, software engineers and fellow data scientists to deliver impactful analytic solutions. in this role, you will take ownership of the full technical lifecycle, handling both the end\-to\-end development and the ongoing support and maintenance of these solutions.


you'll work across the full\-stack technologies to enable the highest priority work to be delivered. within this highly collaborative environment, you will:


* acquire deep understanding of the business problems and translate them into appropriate business solutions.
* drive development and delivery of analytic and statistical models using skills such as data acquisition and management, algorithm design, and model development \& refinement.
* ensure overall quality of the data \& solutions throughout the analytic development process; interpret results and communicate insights to technical and non\-technical audiences including executive leadership.
* agent orchestration \& cognitive architecture: design and program multi\-step reasoning frameworks and agentic loops using modern orchestration tools (e.g., langchain, llamaindex, or haystack).
* context engineering \& advanced rag: architect advanced retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) structures, utilizing embedding models, dynamic chunking strategies, and vector indices to ensure agents receive high\-fidelity business context.
* applied generative ai \& slm strategy: evaluate, select, and adapt small language models (slms) (e.g., phi, mistral, gemma) for domain\-specific agentic tasks. design decision frameworks for model selection based on task complexity, context requirements, latency, and inference cost.
* rigorous system evaluation: establish statistical, model\-driven, and human\-in\-the\-loop testing benchmarks to empirically validate agent reasoning, track accuracy drift, and minimize hallucinations.
* token economics \& efficient agent design: architect agents prioritizing token efficiency, developing strategies for context compression, prompt caching, and dynamic context windowing.
* master's degree in statistics, economics, data science, computer science, engineering, mathematics or relevant degree.
* 5\+ years of experience in statistical or mathematical modeling, machine learning, data science or ai engineering.
* 3\+ years' experience with cloud platforms (e.g. gcp, azure, aws).
* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, developing, and deploying agentic ai solutions, including retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) pipelines and llm/slm integrations.
* 1\+ years of experience in accounting or finance.
* large scale data manipulation and mining/pattern recognition experience.
* developed and implemented machine learning models.
* orchestration mastery: hands\-on capability with modern ai orchestration frameworks, llm apis, and complex behavioral prompt engineering methodologies.
* slm \& fine\-tuning expertise: experience with domain\-specific model adaptation, including parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning and model distillation to embed internal business rules and vocabulary.
* strong oral and written communication skills.
* strong problem formulation and problem solving skills.
* experience communicating findings to make data analysis actionable and understandable by business partners.
* ability to take complex problems and break them down to create and implement an action plan.
* strong understanding of analysis and computational complexity and ability to programmatically solve problems.
* strong capabilities at designing visual interface for data interaction.
  

  

you may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to ford motor company, we encourage you to apply!


as an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. you can choose what your ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? no matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
  

* immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more
* family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* tuition assistance
* established and active employee resource groups
* paid time off for individual and team community service
* a generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between christmas and new year’s day
* paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Network Value (Credit)
description:
**required skills**

* all departments
* data


we believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. we’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. we work with thousands of companies like venmo, sofi, several of the fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the us, canada, uk and europe. founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in san francisco with offices in new york, seattle, washington d.c., raleigh, london, and amsterdam.

**senior data scientist \- network value (credit)**
---------------------------------------------------


the network value data science team is helping plaid build an industry\-leading fintech consumer network with best\-in\-class products and user experiences. we are a product analytics team embedded in key product areas across plaid. we support some of plaid’s most important okrs and help execute on product roadmaps. we translate ambiguous product questions into tractable analysis, serve as analytical thought partners throughout the org, identify opportunities to build better products, and champion a data\-first decision\-making approach everywhere we go.


you’ll be a data scientist supporting credit, a critical product area within plaid’s network value portfolio. you’ll become a data and analytical thought partner to product managers, engineers, and cross\-functional stakeholders, helping shape credit product strategy, improve product performance and user experience, and grow plaid’s consumer network. you’ll translate business questions into analytics projects, perform ad\-hoc and strategic analysis, improve visibility into core systems through data modeling and dashboarding, create okrs and kpis tied to business goals and user experiences, and support feature\-shipping decisions through experimentation. you’ll also work with sql, python, redshift, databricks, notebooks, dbt, and airflow to enable trustworthy analytics and scalable reporting.


today, plaid’s credit business primarily supports income and asset verification solutions. as cash flow data becomes an increasingly important tool across the lender lifecycle \- from acquisition through servicing \- you’ll help build cash\-flow\-based products that enable lenders to approve more borrowers, reduce losses, and reach new segments.

**what excites you**
--------------------

* champion a data\-first approach to decision\-making across plaid and help teams use evidence to set direction.
* partner closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define problems, shape product strategy, and execute against roadmaps.
* translate ambiguous business and product questions into clear analytics projects, decision frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
* perform ad\-hoc and strategic analyses that identify opportunities to improve product performance, user experiences, and business results.
* build and maintain data models, dashboards, core metrics, okrs, and kpis that improve visibility into credit’s systems and quantify progress against goals.
* design and analyze experiments that inform feature launches, iteration, and ship decisions.
* partner on dbt\- and airflow\-powered data pipelines and use sql, python, redshift, databricks, and notebooks to create reliable, scalable analytics.
* identify novel ways to influence top\-line okrs and help stakeholders make thoughtful prioritization, roadmapping, and execution decisions.
* over the next year, shape credit product strategy, improve product performance and user experience, and contribute to growth of plaid’s consumer network.

**what excites us**
-------------------

### **must\-have qualifications**

* 5–8\+ years of experience as a data scientist or in a related analytics or data\-focused role.
* experience as a product data scientist helping grow an early\-stage or consumer\-facing product, ideally from 0 to 1\.
* experience with experimentation, ad\-hoc analysis, and strategic insight generation in a product environment.
* strong sql skills and experience creating metrics that drive alignment and decision\-making with stakeholders.
* experience driving data\-informed performance improvements for user\-facing products.
* experience building or partnering closely on data pipelines using tools such as airflow and dbt.
* a track record of identifying novel ways to impact a top\-line okr and influencing stakeholders on prioritization, roadmapping, and/or execution.
* strong communication skills and the ability to explain analytical methods, tradeoffs, and recommendations to product managers, engineers, and other cross\-functional partners.

### **nice\-to\-have qualifications**

* fintech experience, including experience working with raw fintech or financial transaction data.
* experience with causal inference or machine learning.
* python proficiency.


our mission at plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. to support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. we recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. we encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. we are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to plaid!

title: Delivery Senior Consultant, Data Engineering and Gen AI Conversion Solutions
description:
join deloitte's government \& public services (gps) practice as a **senior consultant, data engineering** and help deliver data solutions that support mission\-driven outcomes. in this role, you will contribute to the design, build, and execution of data engineering and conversion solutions for government clients. you will work across data migration, integration, and validation activities to help clients modernize platforms and scale their data capabilities within deloitte's us delivery center model.  

  

**work you'll do**  

  

as a senior consultant, data engineering on the gps ai \& data team, you will be responsible for...  

* developing, designing, and maintaining cutting\-edge ai\-based systems, ensuring smooth and engaging user experiences
* participating in a wide variety of natural language processing activities, including refining and optimizing prompts to improve the outcome of large language models (llms), and code and design review
* developing and promoting standards across the community
* working with leadership and stakeholders to identify ai opportunities and promote strategy
* building and prioritizing backlog for future machine\-learning enabled features to support client business processes

  

a successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* effective written and verbal communication skills
* meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* ability to lead projects or workstreams
* ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* ability to meet deadlines
* ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**the team**  

  

deloitte's government \& public services (gps) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  

  

our ai \& data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge data and ai platforms, products, insights, and services. our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, ai, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.  

  

this opportunity sits within our deloitte us delivery center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. it leverages deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high\-quality, cost\-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across deloitte.  

  

the deloitte us delivery center has a small\-business feel with a big\-business impact. with the resources of deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high\-quality services to our clients. usdc professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.  

  

**qualifications**  

  

required:  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field or equivalent experience
* 6\+ years of experience programming in python or r with libraries like tensorflow, pytorch, or keras
* 5\+ years of experience with nlp and llm, especially focused on genai technologies such as openai, claude, gemini, etc.
* 2\+ years of understanding of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning
* proven experience with with cloud\-hyperscalers (aws, azure, gcp)
* proven experience with big data technologies, i.e angular, react, nodejs, c\#, .net, java, golang, sql
* ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
* must be able to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role

  

preferred:  

* 1\+ years of experience supporting government or public sector data programs
* master's degree in related technical discipline
* experience working with agile delivery methods
* experience with agentic ai development

  

you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

description:

our ability to serve some of the world’s largest retailers, including walmart, target, costco, and home depot, reflects our commitment to quality and efficiency. at 1 click logistics, we prioritize our employees’ well\-being, fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment that empowers our team to provide the exceptional service our customers expect and contribute positively to our community.

===============


the software engineer supervisor is a pivotal leadership role within the software development organization, responsible not only for the architectural integrity and performance of core applications, but also for guiding the technical direction of the team. this individual plays a critical role in shaping future product capabilities, driving engineering excellence, and mentoring developers across all experience levels.


this role goes beyond execution and sets the standard. this position leads the evolution of applications, champions scalable integration patterns, and ensures systems align with long term business strategy. as a key technical leader, this role influences cross departmental initiatives, elevates team performance, and proactively identifies opportunities for innovation and modernization across the platform.

**duties and responsibilities**
===============================

* system architecture ownership: lead the design, scalability planning, and modernization of enterprise applications. ensure integrations and system logic align with strategic business objectives and emerging industry standards.
* integration strategy \& execution: architect and oversee complex api integrations and data workflows. conduct deep‑dive research into third‑party systems and guide the team in implementing reliable, secure, and efficient connectivity patterns.

* cross‑functional leadership: serve as the primary technical liaison for customer service, operations, and other business areas. translate high‑level business needs into actionable technical plans and ensure alignment across teams.
* full‑stack technical ownership: oversee the end‑to‑end lifecycle of enterprise applications, including frontend components, backend services, and database performance optimization.
* project scoping \& delivery leadership: lead the breakdown of complex business initiatives into technical milestones. provide expert‑level estimation, risk assessment, and delivery planning. ensure projects are executed with clarity, accountability, and technical excellence.
* future scope \& innovation: proactively identify emerging opportunities for platform expansion, new feature development, and architectural improvements. drive proof‑of‑concepts, evaluate new technologies, and help shape the future of the product ecosystem.
* performs other duties as assigned.
**required skills and abilities**
=================================

* tech stack: proven experience with html5, css3, javascript (es6\+), and react.
* backend \& logic: experience with coldfusion (willingness to be trained is acceptable) and mysql.
* api mastery: deep understanding of api methodologies (rest, soap) and data formats (json, xml, csv).
* design patterns: knowledge of software design and architectural patterns.
* tooling: proficiency with git and project/ticket tracking software (e.g., jira, azure devops).
* cloud awareness: experience with cloud environments (aws or azure) specifically regarding application deployment.
* problem solving: excellent analytical skills with a focus on root\-cause analysis rather than just "quick fixes."
* communication: ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* self\-management: ability to prioritize tasks in an agile environment and meet tight deadlines.

we're seeking an exceptional full stack engineer to join our private assets ai team in new york and help build the platform that is changing how the world's largest allocators evaluate funds and managers. our ai\-native diligence platform turns vast volumes of unstructured documents into structured, decision\-ready insights, and this role sits at the center of that product: the interface clients use every day, the services behind it, and the ai features that bring them together. the ideal candidate is a product\-minded generalist with deep experience shipping modern web applications end to end and a passion for working close to clients and their problems.

this role offers a unique opportunity to shape a fast\-growing product at the intersection of ai and private markets, with direct impact on how the world's largest financial institutions invest.


your key ressponsibilities:

your skills and experience that will help you excel:

* solid backend experience in python, including apis and services (fastapi or similar), relational databases (mysql or postgres), and async or background job processing
* experience integrating llm apis into product features, including prompt design, tool calling, and handling model outputs in a user\-facing application, with an appetite to go deeper
* strong product sense, including a clear understanding of user workflows, attention to how features feel to use, and the judgment to make sensible scope trade\-offs
* effective working directly with clients and non\-technical stakeholders, with the ability to communicate clearly in both directions
* comfortable in a lean, fast\-moving team: takes ownership, moves between front end, backend, and ai work as needed, and sees features through to production
* strong plus: experience in financial services, particularly private markets, asset management, wealth management, or fintech

title: Full-Stack Web Developer — Political Technology Startup
description:
**location:** remote  
**employment type:** independent contractor  
**compensation:** revenue share / commission

**about us**

we are an early\-stage political technology startup building an ai\-powered campaign management platform specifically for *conservative* political campaigns.

our founding team brings experience in campaigns, political fundraising, digital strategy, communications, and campaign operations.

we have the political expertise, business vision, and product concept.

**we're looking for the technical builder who can help us turn it into a real product.**

**the opportunity**

we are seeking an experienced **web** **developer** to lead the development of our initial product.

this is an **independent contractor opportunity compensated through a negotiated revenue\-share/commission arrangement rather than a traditional salary or hourly rate.**

the ideal candidate is an experienced developer who wants to get involved at the ground floor of a startup and participate directly in the financial success of the product they help build.

you will work directly with the founding team and have substantial ownership over the technical implementation of the platform.

this is not a typical freelance project where you are handed a specification, complete the assignment, and move on to the next client.

**we're looking for someone who wants to build something long term with us.**

**what we're building**

the platform will combine a modern saas application with commercial ai/llm apis and campaign\-specific knowledge and workflows.

the founding team has developed the initial business concept, target market, and product vision. you will help translate that vision into a production\-ready application and advise the team on technical architecture and implementation.

**responsibilities**

you will take primary responsibility for the technical development of the mvp, including:

* designing the application's technical architecture
* building the frontend and backend
* developing the ai\-powered conversational interface
* integrating commercial llm apis
* developing campaign\-specific ai workflows
* building user authentication and account management
* designing and implementing the database
* integrating subscription and payment functionality
* building administrative functionality
* deploying the application to production
* maintaining and improving the product as it launches
* advising the founding team on technical decisions
* helping establish the technical roadmap as the product grows

**technical requirements**

we are looking for demonstrated experience with modern full\-stack development.

relevant experience includes:

* react / next.js or comparable frontend frameworks
* javascript / typescript and/or python
* backend/api development
* postgresql or other relational databases
* authentication and user management
* cloud deployment
* third\-party api integrations
* saas application development

***ai / llm experience***

experience building applications using modern ai models is strongly preferred.

experience with technologies such as:

* openai
* anthropic
* google gemini
* rag
* vector databases
* ai agents
* tool/function calling
* structured outputs
* prompt engineering
* ai application architecture

**you do not need to be an ai researcher or have trained a foundation model.** we are looking for someone who knows how to turn existing ai models into a reliable, useful software product.

**political technology experience**

political technology experience is preferred but not required.

experience with:

* conservative campaigns
* political consulting
* campaign technology
* political fundraising
* digital campaigning
* political data
* advocacy organizations
* conservative organizations

our company operates within the conservative political ecosystem, and the product is specifically designed for these campaigns. candidates should be comfortable working in this environment and aligned with the company's mission.

**who we're looking for**

the ideal candidate is:

* an experienced software engineer who has actually built and deployed products
* entrepreneurial and self\-directed
* comfortable working from a product vision rather than a fully defined technical specification
* capable of making and defending technical decisions
* excited about ai and emerging technology
* comfortable in an early\-stage startup environment
* a strong communicator who can work directly with non\-technical founders
* interested in participating in the success of a product rather than simply billing hours
* someone who wants meaningful upside in exchange for taking on early\-stage risk

**most importantly, we're looking for a builder.**

you don't need to know every technology we'll ultimately use. you do need to be capable of figuring out how to build the product and solving problems along the way.

**compensation**

this is a **revenue\-share/commission\-based independent contractor opportunity.**

there is no initial salary or hourly compensation. instead, the selected contractor will receive an agreed percentage of revenue generated by the product, subject to the terms of a formal contractor agreement.

the specific revenue\-share percentage, duration, payment structure, and other terms will be negotiated based on the candidate's experience, expected contribution, and level of involvement.

the goal is to create an arrangement in which the developer's financial upside grows as the product succeeds.

**this opportunity is intended for an entrepreneurial developer who seeks meaningful participation in the product's future revenue.**

what we bring

the founding team brings:

* conservative campaign experience
* political fundraising expertise
* digital fundraising expertise
* campaign communications experience
* campaign strategy and operations experience
* an established network within the political ecosystem
* a defined target market
* a developed product concept
* a recurring\-revenue business model

you will not be expected to figure out the political product by yourself.

**we know the customer. we know the problem. we know the political environment. we need someone who can build the technology.**

how to apply

please submit:

* your resume or linkedin profile
* a brief description of your full\-stack development experience
* a brief description of your experience with ai/llm apis
* a brief description of any political, campaign, or conservative\-organization experience (if applicable)
* your anticipated availability and level of commitment

**applicants are encouraged to include examples of previous technical work.**

marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. across enterprise, cloud and ai, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


at marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. for those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

the machine learning platform team develops and operates the infrastructure that powers large\-scale ai and machine learning workloads. the team focuses on enabling scalable, reliable, and efficient ml operations across distributed computing environments, supporting model training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. working at the intersection of ai/ml and systems engineering, the team drives performance, resource efficiency, and operational excellence for next\-generation ai platforms.**what you can expect**

29 \- 57, $ per hour.

title: Data Scientist
description:
ogc is a boutique market research and data analysis consulting firm specializing in customer experience analytics, innovation testing, and data visualization. we are seeking a **data scientist** to join our team.


our mission is to help our clients become more insightful, create happier end customers, and uncover opportunities to grow their businesses. we employ a hands\-on approach to research and consulting: we follow a comprehensive discovery process, apply advanced analysis techniques using state\-of\-the\-art tools, draw conclusions collaboratively in cross\-functional teams, and utilize workshops to foster action.


our client portfolio is international, with a focus on us\-based, fortune 500 companies, across a variety of industries such as financial services, specialty retail, telecommunications, hospitality, and software.

**this position follows east coast (et) hours.**  



the ideal candidate for this position is a bright, independent, detail\-oriented individual, with a strong analytical background, who is passionate about using data to help customers drive strategic decisions and business improvements. they are a methodological problem solver who is driven by curiosity to find answers to challenging puzzles. we are looking for a candidate who loves working with people, has an excellent business acumen, and who is always eager to learn. our data scientists are self\-starters, with a strong technical background and a deep familiarity with data analysis and quantitative research methodologies.


in this role, you will work directly with our clients and deliver consulting projects to senior stakeholders, with the end goal of leveraging data to help our clients drive strategic decisions and business improvements. this position provides an excellent opportunity to apply your strong analytical background to the market research and customer experience domain while working directly with global, fortune 500 companies.

**responsibilities include**

* support the execution of quantitative research and consulting projects from start to finish including project planning, data analysis, modeling, and building insights\-based reports
* work with other data scientists, designers, and project managers on interdisciplinary projects using your skillset to derive structure and knowledge from raw data across various industry sectors
* work on complex and varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real\-world problems
* develop data science products and solutions for clients, as well as for our internal team
* client communication and engagement including building and delivering insights\-based reports
* build, deploy and automate various algorithms (classification, regression, forecasting) and support the production of automated reports and analysis
* transform large volumes of data from internal and external sources in a manner suitable for analysis
* research new data sources, analytical tools, and methodologies for data science and data engineering
* perform complex data analysis in support of ad\-hoc and standing requests, focusing on delivering key insights
* provide an expert point of view on analytical techniques and guidance to our analysts and sales directors

  

* bachelor’s degree from a top university
* ma/ms in data science, computer science, business analytics, or other quantitative field \- an advantage
* 4\+ years of professional experience as a project\-oriented data analyst or scientist
* excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze issues, identify causes, and recommend solutions quickly
* strong quantitative background with a high comfort level for learning new technologies
* diverse technical skills including:
	+ python (high level)
	+ modeling/machine learning
	+ statistics
	+ sql
	+ excel (vba, power pivot, power query, dax \- an advantage)
	+ data visualization (tableau, powerbi \- an advantage)
	+ demonstrated experience with common python packages for data analysis and modeling; including pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, xgboost, jupyter, dask, pyspark, etc. \- an advantage
	+ expertise in one or more specific data science domains (geospatial analytics, dashboards, text analytics, causal inference, cloud computing, etc.) \- an advantage
* must speak and write english fluently and idiomatically

as the ml engineer– drug discovery \& r\&d operations, you will accelerate elanco’s r\&d portfolio by turning proprietary scientific data into predictive models that guide drug discovery and development decisions. you will partner with discovery and development scientists to build machine learning and computer‑vision models on molecular, in vitro, admet, and imaging data to support target identification, molecular optimization, digital biomarkers, and endpoint prediction for animal health.

at crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. with real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. we embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our dna across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. that’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as ai\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. join us at crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**job description:**


job description**about the role**

* as an ai engineering team member, you will be instrumental in advancing new features and/or solutions from the proof of concept stage to full production readiness. your role involves refining and enhancing ai solutions to ensure they are robust, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
* execute on the technical vision for development of ai solutions and delivery of ai features to ensure they are scalable and production\-ready.
* refine user stories and define clear acceptance criteria for feature requests to ensure alignment with business needs.
* write high\-quality, production\-ready code and assist in code reviews to maintain standards of excellence.
* develop and implement comprehensive testing protocols, including smoke tests and unit tests, to ensure solution reliability.
* support the debugging process and issue triage to maintain solution integrity throughout the development cycle.
* participate in ethical reviews and risk/security evaluations to uphold crowe’s standards for responsible ai deployment.

**required skills**

* expertise in python programming and experience with version control systems like git.
* strong ability to work independently and execute tasks efficiently in a dynamic environment.
* proficiency in navigating project ambiguities and iterative testing processes to refine ai solutions.
* excellent communication skills, capable of effectively documenting and presenting technical details to nontechnical stakeholders.

**preferred skills**

* solid understanding of how to align technical outputs with business requirements.
* knowledge of prompt engineering and retrieval augmented generation (rag) and experience with advanced ai tools such as chatgpt enterprise and microsoft copilot, azure ai foundry.
* experience in fine\-tuning large language models (llms).
* previous experience in professional services or a similar industry, with an understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities it presents.

we expect the candidate to uphold crowe’s values of care, trust, courage, and stewardship. these values define who we are. we expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


crowe accepts applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


in compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the united states and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $62,000 \- $100,000 per year. **our benefits:**  

your exceptional people experience starts here. at crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. we care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. learn more about what working at crowe can mean for you!  

  

**how you can grow:**  

we will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. you will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your career coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**more about crowe:**  

crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: crowe llp delivers audit and attest services, and crowe advisory llc provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.

  

the crowe global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world\*. as independent members of crowe global, crowe llp and crowe advisory llc serve clients worldwide. (\*as of july 2026\)  

  

crowe llp and crowe advisory llc (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

  

crowe llp and crowe advisory llc (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to crowe, or any employee or owner of crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of crowe, and free of charge.

  

crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the city of los angeles’ fair chance initiative for hiring ordinance, los angeles county fair chance ordinance, san francisco fair chance ordinance, and the california fair chance act.
please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local ban\-the\-box laws and fair chance ordinances, where applicable.


we are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.


if you are interested in applying for employment with crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our applicant assistance and accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe\-applicant\-assistance\-and\-accommodation

title: Software and Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**position summary**
====================


the scientific computing core (scc) is the technical backbone of the flatiron institute. scc develops, deploys and maintains computational infrastructure from supercomputers to desktop workstations and provides resources, services, and expertise to the institute's research community. we are seeking a software and infrastructure engineer who is passionate about technology, innovation, and science to join the team in maintaining and growing flatiron's research computing resources. they will work in the deployment, operation and maintenance of the flatiron institute’s scientific computing service infrastructure both on prem and in the cloud, and support scientific applications in the flatiron institute scientific computing centers.

  

this is a full\-time position based in simons foundation’s offices in new york city. visit the simons foundation career page to learn more.

**essential** **functions/responsibilities**
============================================

* develop, deploy and maintain software, services and tools that support scientific computing and data\-intensive research.
* work with scientists to translate research requirements into practical software, cloud and infrastructure solutions.
* support and troubleshoot scientific applications and workflows across linux, cloud, containerized and distributed computing environments.
* diagnose performance, reliability and resource\-utilization issues and optimize computational workloads.
* develop automation, apis and operational tools that improve deployment, monitoring and efficiency.
* support reproducible scientific workflows involving large datasets, machine learning, gpus or other advanced computing technologies.
* evaluate and adopt appropriate emerging technologies for scientific applications.
* collaborate across scientific, software engineering and infrastructure teams and contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing.
* perform other duties or tasks as assigned or required.

**minimum qualifications**
==========================

**education**
-------------

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, computational science, mathematics, physics, neuroscience, biology or a related technical or scientific field, or equivalent professional experience.

**experience**
--------------

* 2 to 5 years of professional software engineering, cloud engineering, research computing, scientific computing or related experience. relevant research and substantial technical project experience may also be considered.
* demonstrated experience developing and maintaining production software or cloud\-based services.
* strong programming experience in python and experience with one or more additional languages such as go, java, c\+\+, c\# or similar.
* practical experience working in linux environments.
* experience with cloud computing platforms such as aws, google cloud platform or microsoft azure.
* experience with containers and containerized application environments, including docker; familiarity with kubernetes or similar orchestration technologies is highly desirable.
* experience diagnosing software and infrastructure problems across applications, services, operating systems, networks or computing environments.
* experience with performance analysis, resource utilization, reliability or optimization of production or computational workloads.
* experience developing automation, apis, services or tools that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes.
* experience with scientific computing, computational research, biological data, neuroscience, machine learning or another data\-intensive scientific domain is desirable but not required.
* experience applying computing to scientific, research or data\-intensive problems is desirable.

**related skills \& other requirements**
----------------------------------------

* **software engineering skills**
	+ strong software engineering skills, including experience developing maintainable, tested and documented software.
	+ strong working knowledge of linux, cloud computing and containerized environments.
	+ familiarity with distributed systems, apis, databases and modern software development practices, including git and continuous integration.
	+ ability to troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues across multiple services and identify performance or resource bottlenecks.
	+ experience with automation, scripting and tools that improve deployment, monitoring, configuration and operational efficiency.
	+ understanding of cloud resource management, security and cost\-conscious use of compute, storage and other infrastructure.
	+ ability to work collaboratively across software engineering, infrastructure and scientific teams.
* **scientific computing and application support**
	+ interest in working directly with scientists and supporting computational research.
	+ ability to learn unfamiliar scientific software, data formats and research workflows and develop sufficient domain understanding to diagnose technical problems effectively.
	+ experience building or supporting reproducible computational or data\-processing workflows is desirable.
	+ experience working with computational biology, bioinformatics, neuroscience, imaging or other scientific datasets is a plus.
	+ ability to translate scientific or user requirements into practical software and infrastructure solutions.
	+ interest in supporting neuroscience research and developing familiarity with the applications, data and computational workflows used by neuroscience researchers.
* **ai, gpu and advanced computing experience** (experience in the following areas is beneficial but not required):
	+ gpu\-based computing and familiarity with cuda or gpu\-enabled scientific or machine\-learning applications.
	+ running, debugging or optimizing computational workloads subject to gpu memory or other resource constraints.
	+ machine\-learning frameworks such as pytorch or similar tools.
	+ deployment or operation of ai/ml models and associated data\-processing workflows.
	+ distributed or large\-scale computing environments.
	+ performance testing and optimization of computational workloads.

**required application materials**
==================================

* please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.

**compensation and benefits**
=============================

* the full\-time annual compensation range for this position is $150,000\-$175,000 depending on experience.
* in addition to competitive salaries, the simons foundation provides employees with an outstanding benefits package.

**our commitment to expanding pathways to science \& opportunities for all:**
=============================================================================


many of the greatest ideas and discoveries come from a diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, and experiences. the simons foundation is committed to advancing basic science and mathematics to benefit humankind and expand our collective understanding of our world. as part of our mission, we support partners, programs, and initiatives that seek to broaden the scientific community and open pathways to science and mathematics careers.

  

the simons foundation provides equal opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic disposition, neurodiversity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected category under federal, state, and local law.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**job overview:**

**data engineer**

**renewable energy division**

**position summary**

  

the renewable energy team is seeking a data engineer to develop and maintain the data infrastructure, analytics models, and business intelligence solutions that support project pursuit, estimating, engineering, procurement, and construction operations.

  

this role will focus on integrating and transforming historical construction cost data, labor productivity metrics, and project\-specific attribute data into scalable data models that enable data\-driven decision making. the ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills in databricks, power bi, python, and sql, while also demonstrating the ability to collaborate closely with estimators, engineers, project managers, and operational leaders.


the successful candidate will help build a modern data environment that converts years of project experience into predictive insights that improve bid accuracy, risk assessment, project planning, and overall business performance

 **key responsibilities**

 **data engineering \& integration**

* design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using databricks, python, and sql.
* consolidate and transform data from estimating systems, project controls, erp platforms, labor tracking tools, scheduling systems, and operational databases.
* develop and manage scalable data models that support historical cost analysis, labor productivity benchmarking, and project performance reporting.
* establish standardized data structures that improve consistency across projects and business units.
* ensure data quality, integrity, and traceability throughout the data lifecycle.

**construction \& preconstruction analytics**

* build datasets and analytical models leveraging:
	+ historical construction costs
	+ labor productivity performance
	+ equipment utilization metrics
	+ schedule performance data
	+ project execution outcomes
	+ site\-specific and regional project attributes
* collaborate with estimating and preconstruction teams to identify cost and productivity trends that improve estimating accuracy.
* develop data solutions that support benchmarking, forecasting, and predictive analytics.
* enable analysis of key project drivers including geography, labor availability, engineering complexity, site conditions, contract structure, and execution strategy.

**business intelligence \& reporting**

* develop and maintain power bi dashboards, semantic models, and reporting solutions.
* create executive, operational, and project\-level reporting tools.
* deliver self\-service reporting capabilities for business users.
* improve visibility into project performance and enterprise trends.

**ai \& advanced analytics**

* support ai\-enabled solutions that accelerate data discovery, forecasting, and decision making.
* utilize ai\-assisted development and "vibe coding" techniques to accelerate solution delivery and automate repetitive development tasks.
* explore opportunities to leverage large language models and machine learning techniques for estimating, project benchmarking, and knowledge management.

**development \& collaboration**

* work within a collaborative development environment utilizing github for version control and code management.
* participate in peer reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* partner closely with estimating, engineering, procurement, project controls, operations, and executive leadership teams.
* translate business challenges into practical data solutions.

**required qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, construction management, engineering, data science, information systems, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related disciplines.
* strong hands\-on experience with databricks.
* experience developing power bi reports, semantic models, and dashboards.
* advanced proficiency with python and sql.
* advanced microsoft excel capabilities.
* experience with github and collaborative software development practices.
* experience designing data models for analytics and reporting.
* strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience in renewable energy, epc contracting, heavy civil, utility, industrial construction, or infrastructure industries.
* experience analyzing construction cost data, labor productivity, or project performance metrics.
* knowledge of estimating workflows and project controls processes.
* experience with azure data services and cloud\-based analytics platforms.
* familiarity with machine learning, ai, and microsoft copilot technologies.
* experience developing predictive cost or productivity models.

 **desired technical skills**

* databricks
* power bi
* python
* sql
* github
* excel
* data modeling
* etl/elt development
* azure data platform
* rest apis
* ai\-assisted development
* machine learning fundamentals

 **what success looks like**


within the first year, this individual will:

* establish trusted datasets for historical construction cost and labor productivity analytics.
* develop enterprise reporting and power bi dashboards used by preconstruction and operations teams.
* improve estimate accuracy through data\-driven benchmarking and trend analysis.
* create scalable data models that support future ai and predictive analytics initiatives.
* enable leadership teams to make faster, more informed business decisions using project performance data.

 **target salary 80,000 \- 105,000**

**company overview:**


primoris renewable energy, a business within primoris services corporation’s energy segment, is a leading power generation engineering, procurement, and construction (epc) provider specializing in utility and commercial scale solar power, energy storage, solar repower, and operations and maintenance. standing at the forefront of energy transformation, we are dedicated to doing the right thing for our customers, people, and planet – shaping a more sustainable future for generations to come.**benefits:**

* paid company holidays
* paid time off
* medical, dental, vision, fsa/hsa, short term/long term disability
* 401k with matching contribution.

**eeo statement**
