title: Senior NLP / Machine Learning Scientist
description:
**job summary**

we are seeking a senior nlp / machine learning scientist to join our ai/ml lab and build state\-of\-the\-art nlp models for large\-scale labor market data.

you will develop and productionize models that transform unstructured data such as job postings and professional profiles into structured labor market intelligence. core problem areas include classification, information extraction, entity recognition, normalization, semantic matching, and multilingual nlp.

this role spans the full model lifecycle—from experimentation and fine\-tuning to evaluation, optimization, and production inference at scale.

**responsibilities**

* build nlp models for classification, extraction, normalization, entity linking, and semantic matching.
* develop transformer\-based and embedding\-based models using architectures such as bert, deberta, modernbert, sentence transformers, and modern foundation models.
* fine\-tune and adapt llms using techniques such as supervised fine\-tuning, lora, qlora, peft, and distillation.
* evaluate when to use llms versus smaller task\-specific models based on accuracy, latency, throughput, and cost.
* optimize models for production using quantization, distillation, batching, model compilation, and efficient inference frameworks.
* develop multilingual nlp models and cross\-lingual approaches for global labor market data.
* design robust evaluation frameworks, perform error analysis, and continuously improve model quality.
* partner with ml and data engineers to deploy scalable models and training pipelines in aws.
* stay current with advances in nlp, llms, embeddings, and efficient machine learning, and translate promising research into production systems.
* mentor team members and contribute to technical standards and modeling strategy.

**requirements**

* master's degree or phd in computer science, machine learning, nlp, or a related field.
* strong experience building and deploying production nlp or ml systems.
* deep understanding of transformers, embeddings, classification, information extraction, and entity normalization.
* strong python and pytorch experience; hands\-on experience with hugging face or similar frameworks.
* experience with large\-scale model training, evaluation, and productionization.
* strong problem\-solving skills and ability to independently drive ambiguous ml problems from research to production.
* hands\-on experience fine\-tuning llms or foundation models.
* experience with lora, qlora, peft, instruction tuning, or model distillation.
* experience with model inference optimization, including quantization, onnx, tensorrt, vllm, torchcompile, or gpu optimization.
* experience with multilingual nlp, semantic search, retrieval, entity linking, or knowledge graphs.
* experience with aws, sagemaker, docker, mlflow, or similar mlops tooling.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**job description:**


this role is in based in houston, tx. candidates currently located in the houston, tx are are encouraged to apply.

  

we're looking for a data engineer to design and maintain the data architecture that powers our business systems and analytics — and possess a working knowledge of ai\-powered applications as they become part of that landscape. you'll own how data is modeled, moved, and governed across the organization, and make sure that foundation is solid enough for both traditional reporting and modern ai\-driven tools to build on.


this role sits at the center of a lot of cross\-functional work: you'll partner with application teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to make sure data is structured consistently, documented clearly, and trustworthy wherever it's used.

 **responsibilities**


data architecture \& schema design

* design canonical, well\-documented data models for core business entities (customers, projects, products, contracts, finance, etc.) that multiple systems and teams can rely on as a single source of truth.
* evaluate and evolve schemas as the business and its systems grow — balancing new requirements against long\-term maintainability.
* establish and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices.


pipelines \& integration

* build and maintain etl/elt pipelines that move data reliably from source systems (erp, crm, operational databases, vendor feeds, files) into a cloud data warehouse.
* monitor data quality and pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data issues at the source rather than downstream.
* integrate new data sources — including third\-party platforms and vendor apis — into the existing architecture without duplicating effort or creating conflicting versions of the same data.


data governance

* define and maintain data classification standards (e.g., what counts as sensitive financial, contractual, or customer data) and ensure those standards are applied consistently across systems.
* support access control and audit requirements by ensuring data lineage and usage are traceable.
* maintain a data dictionary and related documentation so other teams can find and trust the data they need.


ai\-aware data engineering

* design data structures and access patterns with an understanding of how they'll be consumed — including by ai/llm\-powered applications that rely on well\-scoped, accurate context rather than raw database access.
* apply minimum\-necessary\-data principles when structuring data that will be surfaced through ai features, in partnership with application and security teams.
* stay current enough on how retrieval\-augmented generation and llm context assembly work to make informed schema and access decisions — this is a working\-knowledge requirement, not a machine learning role.


collaboration

* work with engineering, product, and business teams to translate reporting and application needs into sound data models.
* act as a technical resource and point of contact for data\-related questions across multiple concurrent projects.

 **technical skills**

**required**

* 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or data architecture, including hands\-on schema/data model design in a production environment.
* strong sql skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse (snowflake and msft sql server preferred)
* experience sql query language
* experience building and maintaining etl/elt pipelines.
* solid understanding of data governance fundamentals: classification, access control, and documentation practices.
* working knowledge of how modern ai/llm applications consume data — context windows, retrieval\-augmented generation, and the basics of why minimizing and scoping data matters for these systems.
* strong communication skills; comfortable being the person other teams come to for data questions.


preferred

* experience in a distribution, industrial supply, or erp\-adjacent environment.
* familiarity with integrating third\-party saas platforms via api.
* experience with ci/cd tooling (e.g., github actions) and cloud application environments (e.g., aws).
* experience consolidating multiple existing data models into a shared standard.


nice to have

* exposure to bi/reporting tools (e.g., power bi) and how they consume the underlying data model.
* working knowledge of python

title: AI-Native Application Software Engineer
description:
**company overview:**


one park financial (opf) is a leading financial technology company dedicated to empowering small businesses by connecting them with flexible financing and funding options. our mission is to provide entrepreneurs with the working capital they need to elevate their businesses. at opf, we believe in working with high\-performing individuals who are ready to play an integral part in our company's expansion — because our success hinges on our people.

**why join us? position overview**


at opf, we foster a dynamic and inclusive company culture that emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. our team is composed of passionate, driven individuals who are committed to making a difference. here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

* innovative environment: work with cutting\-edge technology and be part of a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of fintech.
* professional growth: we invest in our employees’ growth with continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and career advancement paths.
* supportive culture: enjoy a supportive and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your contributions make a real impact.
* community focus: be part of a company that understands the importance of small and mid\-sized businesses to their communities and the nation’s financial health.
* high\-performing team: join a team of badasses who are committed to excellence and are integral to our company's expansion and success.

**position overview**


we are looking for an ai\-native application software engineer to help design, build, evolve, and operate a modern cloud\-based software platform serving thousands of small and micro\-businesses.


this is not a traditional software engineering role where success is primarily measured by how much code an engineer writes. the modern engineer understands the business problem first, frames it precisely, uses ai to accelerate design and implementation, understands how the resulting solution fits into the broader technology ecosystem, and owns whether the solution works for the customer.


ai is an integral part of the engineering process. the engineer uses ai to research, design, generate code, create tests, investigate problems, explore alternatives, document systems, and accelerate delivery—while directing, challenging, and validating ai\-generated work.

**what we are looking for**

* **deep subject\-matter expertise** understands the business and knows what “correct” means.
* **exceptional problem framing** turns ambiguity into clear requirements and solutions.
* **ai orchestration** uses ai effectively while challenging and validating its output.
* **systems thinking \& breadth** understands how ui, applications, apis, data, cloud, security, and integrations fit together.
* **curiosity \& continuous learning** naturally investigates, experiments, learns, and adapts

**what you'll do**

* understand customer workflows and translate business needs into software solutions.
* turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, architecture, and acceptance criteria.
* use ai as an engineering collaborator for research, design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and optimization.
* review and challenge ai\-generated solutions and remain accountable for the final result.
* develop full\-stack applications using react, node.js, javascript/typescript, and mongodb.
* build and operate cloud applications using aws, docker, kubernetes/eks, cloudfront, alb, route 53, acm, and related services.
* work with multi\-tenant websites, customer\-owned domains, dns, ssl certificates, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
* build business workflows including websites, lead capture, estimates, invoices, receipts, business email, analytics, and communications.
* integrate external services such as twilio, whatsapp business platform, amazon connect, google analytics, and other apis.
* diagnose and resolve production issues across the entire technology stack.
* automate repetitive engineering processes and continuously improve development and deployment workflows.
* learn and experiment with new ai models, tools, apis, and architectures.

**qualifications**

* strong experience with modern full\-stack application development.
* strong react, node.js, javascript/typescript, and database experience.
* experience with cloud\-based applications, preferably aws.
* experience working with apis, integrations, ci/cd, and production systems.
* strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* ability to work independently and across technical boundaries.
* demonstrated ability to use ai effectively in software development.
* most importantly, the ability to understand the problem, ask the right questions, and own the outcome.

  

**requirements**  

* 3\+ years of professional software development experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.
* strong javascript/typescript experience.
* strong react experience.
* strong node.js experience.
* experience developing rest apis.
* experience with mongodb or another modern database.
* experience with git and modern software development workflows.
* experience developing and debugging production applications.
* understanding of cloud\-based application architecture.
* strong problem\-solving ability.
* ability to work across the full technology stack.

**preferred experience**

* aws cloud development and operations.
* docker and kubernetes/eks.
* mongodb atlas.
* typescript.
* playwright or comparable end\-to\-end testing.
* google analytics and looker studio.
* twilio, whatsapp business platform, or amazon connect.
* aws end user messaging and ses.
* dns automation and customer\-owned domain management.
* multi\-tenant saas platforms.
* mobile webviews.
* cursor or similar ai development environments.
* ai coding agents and agentic development workflows.

  

**benefits**  

* competitive salary
* health insurance
* growth and development opportunities
* dynamic and collaborative work environment
* company events and team\-building activities
